limitations: Full 16MB read timed out at 180s; no full-flash backup claim. Verified ct45 application rollback and separate 128KiB pre-application backup retained privately.
Only first post-boot NVS snapshot compared; startup refreshed websocket token, saved Wi-Fi and user values unchanged. Second restart is separately observed, not a second semantic NVS snapshot.
Logical output state and startup GPIO reports do not measure physical output levels, mechanical stopping, flow, bubbles or safety.
No actuator commands, ignition/high-voltage test, human microphone, speaker or family acceptance in this deployment.
